_pack_note: Two separate animations matter here. (1) A pack tears open and materializes cards with a dissolve shader; such a frame has 5 card-sized blobs scoring 0.08-0.22, so blob count alone is not readiness. (2) Every card carries a permanent ambient_tilt that Card:draw recomputes each frame, so even settled cards never hold still -- one slot measured 0.285-0.748 across 40 frames, and detected boxes wandered up to 111px. Hence a MEAN gate (settled 0.60-0.74 vs unsettled ~0.13) plus a per-slot floor above the unsettled ceiling of 0.216. scan_frames is generous because the Soul verdict is taken across every frame sampled.
_detector_note: Scale is derived from window height via card_height_frac, not swept: at 2560x1599 the cards render 1.58x the template's native size. region confines the search to the card row; searching the whole window scored 0.46 on the animated backdrop.
_threshold_note: Set from measured data, biased toward recall. Real Soul-free packs scored 0.235/0.271/0.339; the Soul composited into real frames scored 0.722-0.844. 0.55 sits near the midpoint. The asymmetry matters: a missed Soul silently costs ~500 resets, while a false positive just stops the bot with screenshots.
_coords_note: Normalized (0..1) positions within the Balatro CLIENT rect, so they survive a resize. Measured live at 2560x1599 via tools/calibrate.py.

coords._neutral_note: Cursor is parked here before reading a pack. The skip_big button sits inside the card row, so leaving the cursor there raises a card and pops a tooltip over its neighbours.
